Name: Dermatology Specialists
About:
Dermatology Specialists is a privately-owned, full-service dermatology practice that puts patients first. Our team of board certified MDs and Certified Physician Assistants (each in practice for 10+ years) offer patients a comprehensive menu of surgical, medical, and cosmetic services, with treatments covering the full breadth of skin-related health care needs. 

With deep roots across the greater Denver area, Dermatology Specialists prioritizes the patient experience from their first contact with our in-house Patient Care Coordinator Team, to our in-office experience at any of our four modern, convenient locations in Boulder, Brighton, Louisville, and Westminster.

Name: Dermatology Specialists
About:
Dermatology Specialists is recognized as one of the premier dermatology practices in the upper Midwest. We currently have 14 board-certified dermatologists who work together to provide professional, personable, and complete skin care for all ages. Our practice prides itself in state of the art treatment for medical and cosmetic skin care with two convenient locations in Edina and Eden Prairie. We provide Mohs surgery for skin cancer, Narrowband Ultraviolet B therapy for psoriasis and eczema, Excimer laser for vitiligo and psoriasis, Fraxel laser, pulsed-dye laser, Botox, and fillers as well as other cosmetic procedures performed by our highly experienced cosmetic providers. These procedures include Halo, BBL, laser hair removal, microneedling, chemical peels, and microdermabrasions. Our paramedical staff takes pride in their work as caring health professionals while keeping the patient’s best interest in mind.

Dermatology Specialists cares about the entire patient experience. We look forward to the future of our practice as we continue to excel and uphold our core values of accountability, caring, and excellence with the goal of building relationships that stand the test of time.

Name: Windermere Medical Spa & Laser Institute
About:
Windermere Medical Spa & Laser Institute is Central Florida’s premier destination for medical aesthetics, laser technology, and regenerative skin health. Known for innovation, artistry, and clinical excellence, we are home to The Princess Injector®—a nationally recognized leader in cosmetic injectables—and Beauty Bank®, Central Florida’s most popular medical spa membership with over 1,200 active members.

With two locations in Windermere and Winter Park, FL, our expert team of advanced injectors and skin specialists help clients achieve natural, confidence-boosting results through treatments like Botox®, Dysport®, dermal fillers, Sculptra®, laser skin resurfacing, hair removal, PRF, microneedling, Biologique Recherche® facials, chemical peels, and IV therapy.

Our proprietary techniques, including the MK Pout™ and full-face balancing protocols, have attracted clients nationwide seeking refined, natural results without looking “overdone.”

We are proud to be the only medical spa in Central Florida offering Biologique Recherche® skincare and treatments—an exclusive, science-backed skin health line trusted by skincare professionals worldwide.

As pioneers in membership-based aesthetics, our Beauty Bank® program makes luxury beauty more accessible with monthly banking, VIP perks, and member-only pricing on services and retail. Members can further elevate their experience with BB On Repeat, our exclusive monthly routine featuring facials, head spa treatments, or IV therapy.
